swimming_pool.evidence: The round above-ground pool at left sits on the neighboring lot, not the central one. A tiny blue object near the right edge of the central house is too small to call a pool and is probably a tarp or toy.

play_equipment.evidence: A magenta/red rectangle on the patio below the house could be a cover or furniture, but it is not clearly play equipment. The round teal object at left is on the neighboring lot.

detached_structure.evidence: A fenced rectangular enclosure sits north of the house near the driveway. It looks like a fenced yard or kennel run rather than a clear building.

signals.notes: Heavy mature tree canopy surrounds the house on the south and east sides; there is a stone patio at the rear and a fenced pen area to the north. The visible hipped roof looks fairly uniform, with some tree shadow.
